title: MEIKO — Looking For Answers〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hmm...
This doesn't sound right. It's too simple. Maybe triplets is the way to go...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, Ichika. Hello.
Is something wrong?
Is it just you?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes...
I'm sorry to bother you in the middle of practice like this, MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, don't mind me!
Come in, come in!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Is something bothering you?
You don't look so great...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Today's, well... It's sort of a big day...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: A big day?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Do you know what it means...?
What's needed to become a pro...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Is this about Shiho...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see. Do you think your answer will satisfy her?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm not sure...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
This really is a tough one.
Actually trying to become a pro...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The other two were in the same boat as you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Sorry...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We're here...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Saki, Honami?!
Wait, don't tell me...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Bands are strange things, aren't they?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Bands are all about bringing different instruments together to create songs and music together, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sometimes you won't agree on anything, maybe end up in heated arguments, but you're all bandmates in the end...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's as if your feelings are coming together and trying to guide you to the right answer.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Our feelings are guiding us...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. It's a mysterious but wonderful phenomenon, no?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I see. I understand what you're trying to say.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Tell me, what part of being a band do you find the most appealing?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The most appealing...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It might be hard to point to just one thing...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're right. Why are we together like this...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Maybe because we can't make this music on our own. We have to be together to create this sound?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: When we play in sync, everything changes...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: When we're playing well, each beat, each note turns into more. Our performance becomes more than the sum of its parts.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know it doesn't make any sense, but that's what it sometimes feels like...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's as if we're aiming for the same goal and seeing the same thing...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, I totally get that!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I do too. That sense of being one is indescribable!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, that! Is that what people mean by being in a groove?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That might be it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. You may want to remember that feeling. It's something that you can only achieve as a band.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, pursuing that may also be part of having fun as a band and even becoming a pro...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I mean, it has to be pretty tough to keep doing something that's hard or causing you pain, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Pursuing that feeling...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Anyways, I think you should always remember why it's so fun to be in a band.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And tomorrow's your big day too, right? Make sure to get plenty of sleep...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Right.
The rest is up to us...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay. Good night, MEIKO.
You too, Hona, Ichi...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Good night.
And thank you, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: My pleasure! Sleep tight!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They'll be fine. I'm sure of it...
